desc: Revolutionize your shooting experience and upgrade the concealed carry potential of a SIG-SAUER P365 XMacro with the Wilson Combat P365 XMacro grip module. Their molded polymer grips will not only improve your grasp on the gun but also control recoil better than before. With its redesigned shape, texture, and ergonomics, these models are designed to give you that custom handcrafted feel in no time at all. Their fresh look at the P365 XMacro grip module incorporates the suggestions of tactical trainers, champion shooters, and firearms experts into the final product that has a look that is unmistakably Wilson. Wilson believe it is the most practical, comfortable, and stylish P365 XMacro grip available and the ideal choice for concealed carry and defensive handgun use.
